# set channel

Establish observe-only authority, optionally writing a value.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `statement.set` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | Statements |
| Family | Authority |
| Monaco kind | `statement` |
| Format | `set \|portal/channel.value\| [= <value>]` |
| Valid contexts | `caesar_execution`, `shared_helper` |
| Autocomplete | `set \|portal/channel.value\| = value` |

## Example

```lua
set |portal/channel.value| = value
```
